notes.title: Indie Mode
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33668628/e6b42c1395e7cb1bdbc1433e733917920d4707a3.jpg[/img]

Being an indie is a state of mind, a way to be in the hype, hum... well i decided to add a complete useless thing to the game, and so completely unavoidable : [b] the Indie Mode.[/b] 

Cute is not your thing? you prefer to play the last perfect indie asbtract game? Not a problem, just enter the indie mode to play Swap Swap the pastel way.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33668628/c6ce6a70ee18297814357916b4ca4290e3996df8.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Swap Swap is now multilingual
notes.notes: I'm happy to announce that for its launch, the game is available in English, French, Italian, Spanish and German.
